method: Research performed 2026-10-18 using web search, direct fetches of official vendor/retailer pages and PDFs, and a browser for JavaScript-rendered pages. Retailer-vendor associations were checked against the retailer's own filings and infrastructure (annual reports, exchange filings, retailer-hosted portals), the vendor's own website, and then secondary material; user-generated content and unsourced blogs were recorded but never treated as confirmation. Status meanings: verified = confirmed by primary evidence from the retailer and/or vendor; partially_verified = credible indirect evidence or only part of the claim confirmed; unverified = no credible evidence found; contradicted = evidence against. Integration facts for the common systems come only from official vendor documentation pages that loaded during this session (pages that returned HTTP 403 or only a JavaScript shell are noted). 'public_api.available=false' means no public, documented API was found - private or partner-only interfaces may still exist; null means unknown. 'export_formats' lists data formats documented for the API or documented export features; product UI exports were not otherwise verified. Countries are given only where an official page stated them. Nothing was inferred from memory.

Registry data classifies it under 'other computer related activities' (NIC 7290); paid-up capital is Rs 1 lakh and the last filed balance sheet shown is for 31 Mar 2023. reported_association.claim: YASH Systems Private Limited is the system/vendor associated with DMart.
reported_association.finding: No company registered under the exact name 'YASH Systems Private Limited' was found in the sources we checked (registry aggregators and web search; the MCA portal was not queried directly). The closest match is Yash Systems India Pvt Ltd (Nagpur). It is NOT YASH Technologies Pvt Ltd (Indore-based SAP/IT services firm; no DMart link found) and NOT Yash Systems Manufacturing Co. Pvt Ltd (Pune machinery maker). Only non-authoritative, user-generated or unsourced material links Yash Systems India to DMart: a 2017 Justdial user review, a 2019 directory enquiry, and a January 2026 personal Medium blog that claims DMart stores run a system called 'R-Soft' from Yash Systems with SAP at head office. A primary DMart filing (May 2026) confirms DMart uses SAP ERP (an executive led its 'SAP ERP transformation'), but no DMart filing, press release, vendor case study or job posting names Yash Systems or any POS vendor. Treat as an unconfirmed lead and confirm directly with Avenue Supermarts IT.

providers.name: EcoGreen (C-Square Info-Solutions) - candidate for the tentative name 'EcoLite'
providers.description: Indian pharmacy and retail software vendor. Products include EcoGreen (multi-store pharmacy/retail ERP with admin, store/franchise and warehouse modules and interval-based branch synchronisation), EcoGreen Express, EcoGreen Lite (low-cost standalone POS on Jio PC), LiveOrder (B2B ordering), PharmAssist (distribution) and StoreTrack. reported_association.claim: 'EcoLite' (tentative name) is the system associated with Wellness Forever.
reported_association.finding: No product called 'EcoLite' was found. The closest match is C-Square's EcoGreen family; 'EcoGreen Lite' is a single-store POS, so a 375-450-store chain would more plausibly use the multi-store EcoGreen ERP. Indirect evidence links Wellness Forever to C-Square: (1) a student field report on a Wellness Forever store (Pune, c.2014-2017) says stock was kept on 'ECOGREEN' software with nightly transfer to head office; (2) Wellness Forever's official Android app uses package id com.c2info.wellnessforever - the same 'com.c2info.' namespace used by apps published by C-Square Info-Solutions Limited, consistent with C-Square having built it. Neither company has publicly confirmed which POS/ERP Wellness Forever runs today. Wellness Forever separately uses Blue Yonder category-management software (vendor customer story).
